description: This file implements a database compatibility driver for IBM DB2 and Oracle within the ADOdb PHP database abstraction library. It includes functions for remapping bind variables and classes extending database connection and record set functionalities specific to DB2/Oracle.

classes.name: ADODB_db2oci
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_db2 to handle DB2/Oracle compatibility, specifically overriding the _Execute method for bind variable remapping.

classes.name: ADOREcordSet_db2oci
classes.description: A class extending ADORecordSet_odbc tailored for DB2/Oracle compatibility, specifying the databaseType as 'db2oci'.

methods.name: _colontrack
methods.description: Callback function used in preg_replace_callback to remap bind variables like :0, :1 to '?' and track their order.

methods.name: _colonscope
methods.description: Remaps positional bind variables in SQL statements from :0, :1 format to ?, and orders parameters accordingly.
